_doc: Every fight in place (design/ruins/content.md). R1 has the night patrol in the College ruins; R2 adds the halls. waves run one after another (the next starts when the yard is clear); with survive > 0 they arrive on a timer instead and the fight is won by lasting that many seconds. lethal: losing ends the loop. unkillable: kinds that are knocked down (for down_time seconds) instead of dying. hits: a duel won by the first to land that many hits of at least hit_min damage; trickle: in a survive fight, one more Hollow every that many seconds; tell: the rival always opens with his lance, and stands for lance_recover seconds after each one. leash: in the town, how far (sim px) the mist lets you stray from where the fight began (220 unless given). max_alive: the trickle waits while that many enemies are up. light_shy: false means the Hollows ignore lamplight (the tide is too many for it); otherwise they won't step into a lit lamp's pool.
